issue.title: Bank import keeps Amazon's spaced order code (RETA* BV5NH), so every Amazon row gets a unique payee

task_type_fields.impact: Every Amazon row gets a unique, noisy payee, so `merchant_key` never repeats for Amazon. The learned payee, category, and link tier (tier 3) can never carry a name or category from one Amazon purchase to the next. Subscription and candidate grouping also see each order as a new merchant. The Category card's planned past-note completion works around this with its own merchant key. Fixing it in bob would make the vault payees clean as well.
task_type_fields.repro:
Wells Fargo QFX descriptions for Amazon put a space between the `*` and the order code: `AMAZON RETA* BV5NH PURCHASE 05/03 WWW.AMAZON.CO WA CARD ••••` (seen in the vault's `.bob/bank/*.jsonl` import journal). `strip_processor_order_code` in `src/native/bank/naming.rs` splits each whitespace word on `*`. For `RETA*` the part after the star is empty, so it is kept. `BV5NH` has no star, so it is kept too. The order code survives cleaning.

Live evidence: `bank/2026-11.md` has `Amazon Reta* Ue4v4`, `Amazon Reta* Pd4tc`, `Amazon Reta* Vr389`, `Amazon Reta* Ni5ca`, `Amazon Reta* Xw6w4`, and `Amazon Reta* E412n`. Every Amazon purchase becomes a different payee. The naming tests cover the glued forms (`GROCERY SHOP *AB12`) but not the `WORD* CODE` form.

Fix sketch: also treat the single token after a word ending in `*` as an order code when it is 1–12 alphanumerics with a digit (keeping word-only sub-merchants like `DELIVERY *SUSHI`). Then drop the stray trailing `*`. Add a fixture for `AMAZON RETA* BV5NH PURCHASE 05/03 WWW.AMAZON.CO WA CARD ••••` → `Amazon Reta` (or the cleaner's canonical title).

issue.creation_reason: Found while designing past-note completion for the Bank Category card: all Amazon rows in bank/2026-11 carry distinct 'Amazon Reta* <code>' payees, so bob's learned naming can never repeat for Amazon.

payload.description: Earlier QFX cleaning bug whose fix added glued *CODE stripping but missed the spaced WORD* CODE form
Compare a bounded reproducible correctness fix for the fifth next-epic task

payload.entry: strip_processor_order_code now peeks one short digit-bearing token after a star-terminated word, so AMAZON RETA* BV5NH and AMAZON RETA* UE4V4 both clean to AMAZON RETA / merchant_key amazon reta. Reused is_short_digit_code (including masked ••••). Preserved DELIVERY *SUSHI, glued *CODE, trailing lone stars, oversized/non-code suffixes, and the never-empty fallback. Verified: cargo test --lib bank::naming bank::identity import_plan (16+42 passed, including spaced_amazon_order_codes_reuse_a_learned_name and spaced_amazon_order_codes_share_a_learned_merchant); sase tool run check 74177a6e912475955d8cdf4c550280c4 succeeded. Did not migrate the live journal or rewrite historical payees.
